intro.title: What is this about?
intro.what: Cinemas collect their experiences with film distributors here: who distributes a film, who answered requests, which formats were possible and whom to contact.
intro.who: The entries come from the cinemas themselves. The database is a voluntary service with no profit motive. Contact details and the names of requesting cinemas are visible after logging in.
intro.caveat: All information may be outdated or incomplete. When in doubt, ask the distributor directly.

who.title: Who is behind this
who.bkf: The project is being developed within the Bundesverband kommunale Filmarbeit e.V. (BkF), the German federation of municipal cinemas, which also connects film-cultural initiatives and institutions.
who.agUnikino: It is an initiative of the AG Unikino within the BkF.
